lf_definition: One physical record is split by literal U+000A only. Formfeed is not an LF record delimiter.
limitations: Native OCR reconstruction geometry only, with literal OCR glyphs and source line-end hyphens. No original-print facsimile or lexical collation. Producer inspection does not supply independent cold source/PDF acceptance.
match_definition: Exact same-native-page line identity after removing Unicode whitespace. Native geometry groups only bbox line elements with exactly equal line yMin and sorts their complete unchanged WORDs by xMin; every selected line has one matching group. No WORD appears in two selected LF records.
